title: docs: one North Star — docs/NORTH-STAR.md; the architecture page moves to concepts/architecture-overview
body:
Fixes #26073
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:「北极星」从此只指 `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`。原架构页 `concepts/north-star` 改名为 `concepts/architecture-overview`(旧网址 308 永久跳转),删掉会过期的 Built、Drift To Keep Shrinking 两节。AGENTS.md(第 7 行与 Prime Directive 8)、ROADMAP、CONTRIBUTING、README 四处入口统一指向它。`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 末尾加了一节英文摘要,中文原文一字未动。
- 为什么改:执行裁决 A′(6417934431,「同意」)。两份同名文件让读者有一半概率打开错的那份,而真正高于 AGENTS.md 的那份,英文贡献者读不了。
- 风险与回滚:只改文档,不碰任何发布包。站外指向旧网址的链接由 redirects 表兜底。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 末尾的英文摘要:是否忠实于中文原文、有没有新增规则;② `AGENTS.md` 第 7 行与 Prime Directive 8 的新措辞;③ `content/docs/concepts/architecture-overview.mdx`。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main...HEAD -- docs/NORTH-STAR.md | grep -c '^-[^-]'`,应输出 `0`,即中文原文没有删改任何一行。
- 需要你做的:本 PR 是 Tier H(改了 `AGENTS.md` 和 `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`)。请审阅英文摘要与 PD8 的措辞,然后用 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 里的账号批准本 PR。

## What changes

Ruling A′ (comment 6417934431), all three items:

1. **The architecture page gets an honest name.** `content/docs/concepts/north-star.mdx` is renamed to `architecture-overview.mdx`, with a new title and nav title. It keeps Principles, Runtime Shape, Environment Artifact, Request Resolution and Non-Goals. The **Built** and **Drift To Keep Shrinking** sections are removed. One sentence under the opening diagram now points readers to the North Star for goals and priority. `content/docs/concepts/meta.json` lists the new slug. `apps/docs/redirects.mjs` gains one entry, `/docs/concepts/north-star` → `/docs/concepts/architecture-overview`, so the old URL answers a permanent redirect.
2. **One North Star.** `AGENTS.md` line 7 and Prime Directive 8 now point at `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`. Prime Directive 8 is re-pointed at that file's 路上的功能点 ladder, graded by its 优先级, and no longer refers to "§7 Built / Drift / Missing". `ROADMAP.md` line 4 and `CONTRIBUTING.md` name `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` as the one North Star. The README Community line linked the site page and now links the file. The two hand-written site pages that linked the old slug now link the new one: `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` (only the link line changed) and `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` (two links).
3. **English summary.** `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` gains a `## English summary` section under the Chinese text. It covers the four opening questions, the one measure (the road), and how to read the ladder, including how grading reads it. It says that the Chinese text governs. It carries no numbers, following that page's own 账本 rule, and it adds no rule. The Chinese original is untouched: 53 lines are added and none are removed.

`scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json` was regenerated by its generator (`node scripts/docs-audit/check-audit-scope.mjs --write`; +1 added, -1 removed).

No changeset (`skip-changeset`): every changed path is either private (`apps/docs`, the root package) or unpublished (docs, `content/docs`, `scripts/`).

## Tests

This diff is docs-only, so it has no unit tests. Verification is the derived gate list, run on the final head `43cb2c7e83`. See Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **Re-derived "five site pages".** Five pages on `origin/main` linked or named the old page. Two are hand-written and were moved: `concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` L174 and `data-modeling/formulas.mdx` L29 and L695. Two are GENERATED and were left alone: `references/shared/expression.mdx` L55 and `references/system/environment-artifact.mdx` L45. One is RELEASE-OWNED and was left alone: `releases/v17/17-6.mdx` L1483, whose URL the new redirect covers.
- **Generator sources of the two generated mentions, not edited here (as dispatched).** These are plain-text paths, not links, so the redirect does not rescue them:
  - `packages/spec/src/shared/expression.zod.ts:59`, which renders as `references/shared/expression.mdx`, cites `north-star.mdx §8 "No private expression DSL"`.
  - `packages/spec/src/system/environment-artifact.zod.ts:46`, which renders as `references/system/environment-artifact.mdx`, cites `§6.3`.

  The same kind of mention is in `packages/spec/src/data/hook-body.zod.ts:256` ("Metadata-only runtime"), `packages/formula/src/index.ts:8` and `packages/formula/README.md:9` (the formula README is published). All five cite sections that were already missing from the page on base `e4ba846f`, because the page has no numbered sections and no such headings. They were stale before this PR, and the rename makes the file path dangling as well. Fixing them means choosing a new citation and spending a changeset plus `gen:docs`, which is outside this card. carrier: none.
- **Release-owned history keeps the old path.** Root `CHANGELOG.md` L1033 links `content/docs/concepts/north-star.mdx`, and it also mentions "§7 Missing in the North Star" at L1125. The rule for release-owned text is not to edit it.
- **The card's confidence gap, measured.** `git grep concepts/north-star` across `README.md`, `ui/`, `apps/docs` and the redirects ledger found one hit: README L270, a site link, now re-pointed to `./docs/NORTH-STAR.md`. `ui/` has one North Star reference, `ui/ROADMAP.md:14`, and it already points at `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`. `apps/docs` had no entry for the slug before this PR. Inbound links from outside the repository cannot be measured from here, and the permanent redirect covers them.
- **`AGENTS.md` line 7 lost its `(先做什么: goals, priority)` parenthetical.** `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` holds `AGENTS.md` to 120 bytes per line, and the file sits at its 1112-line ceiling with zero headroom. A version that kept the parenthetical (152 B) went red, and wrapping it would add a line the ceiling does not allow. The line now reads "`docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, the North Star, outranks it; `content/docs/concepts/architecture-overview.mdx` = architecture." (116 B). What the North Star governs is still stated in Prime Directive 8 and in the summary.
- `ROADMAP.md`'s "Last updated" date was left unchanged, because only the source-of-truth pointer moved.
